dedupe_keys.name: airgriwrm semi distributed gr rainfall runoff model networks with reservoirs withdrawals and diversions r package

description: airGRiwrm is an R package on CRAN (version 0.7.0, published 22 September 2024) for integrated water resource management modelling built on the airGR family of GR rainfall-runoff models. Contents: it links GR models of sub-catchments into a semi-distributed network and integrates human infrastructure and its management; the package vignettes, based on the Severn basin, show how to set up and calibrate a semi-distributed GR4J network, calibrate an open-loop model of influenced flows, model a regulated withdrawal with closed-loop control, handle ungauged stations and model a regulated diversion. Producer: INRAE; author and maintainer David Dorchies, with contributions from Olivier Delaigue and Guillaume Thirel. Coverage: any basin with rainfall, evapotranspiration and flow data. Format and access: R package on CRAN with a reference manual, vignettes, a documentation website and CRAN DOI 10.32614/CRAN.package.airGRiwrm; it is listed in the CRAN Hydrology task view. Licence: AGPL-3 (CRAN metadata). Caveats: lumped-conceptual GR models give catchment-scale flows, not hydraulics, and managed releases must be written as user rules. Simulation uses: testing reservoir release rules and abstraction limits for water supply, drought and low-flow management, and flow inputs for flood and supply studies. Related records: platform-airgr and model-gr4j.
